status: Laptop EC status projection and power getter executed offline; no entry-result read established

source.source_scope: BIOS314-supplied FA507-family EC image, not live flash readback

status_projection.when_raw_bit0_clear: Clears the entire selected cached byte.
status_projection.when_raw_bit0_set: Updates mapped bits and preserves other cached bits.
status_projection.failed_read: Skips projection and preserves the previous cached byte. A failed b1 read can still be followed by the CC read if the old cache satisfies its gate.
status_projection.scope: All 256 raw-byte values exercised for each selector and two cache seeds. Physical connector mapping and raw-bit semantic names remain unestablished. This is not a complete inventory of every EC read path.

power_path.gate: Cached0794 bits7/6 set and bit3 clear
power_path.fixture_encoding: Big-endian fixed PDO; voltage in50mV units at bits19:10; current in10mA units at bits9:0. These are supplied test inputs, not measured contracts.
power_path.failed_read: Leaves previous power result unchanged in the tested path.
power_path.consumer: bank3 be59 uses05bf to select a local power-reporting state; c60a copies05bf and voltage/current values into05b1..05b5.
power_path.meaning_limit: Fixed-PDO correspondence and tested arithmetic support power reporting. No raw reply, actual contract or USB4 link result was read.

oem_getters.field20_result: Returns02 when05bf is nonzero; otherwise00. No bus request is made.
oem_getters.neighbour_result: All fourteen return constant00 in tested original getter paths.
oem_getters.windows_limit: Same PMC4 receiver family used by the completed version getter. These additional fields were executed offline only; no new Windows query or raw status getter was demonstrated.

observed_instruction_paths: BD fixture01 produces BC FD write
BD fixture00 plus interrupt bit1 clear produces BC FF write
Feature gate clear produces no transfer
event_effects.meaning: The complete status-service routine can acknowledge events. It is not a passive diagnostic entry point. Peripheral meanings beyond prior ITE event correspondence and exact instruction effects are not assumed.

comparison.conclusion: No equivalent Enter_USB response field was identified among these laptop EC reads and OEM getters. The four-byte CC power descriptor is not the reference four-byte transition record.
comparison.limit: This does not establish absence of a private entry record in the PD controller or every possible Windows-access path. Raw status bits and controller-side producers are still missing.

validation.bus_boundary: Original1ff4 call is replaced with supplied RAM replies/success values; original consumers and PMC4 receiver execute. Only explicitly listed peripheral locations are allowed.
validation.attempts: Initial build launch used a wrong relative path and did not compile or execute. Corrected launch built successfully; first firmware test execution passed. Logs retained privately.

next_question: Identify the controller-side producer and meaning of normal-register status bytes, or another matched register holding the entry response. Do not repeat the power/cache reads as handshake diagnostics. Any Windows transport remains a separate requirement.
